name: Musca
introduction: is the Fly, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s. It lies in the southern Milky Way just south of the Southern Cross.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Part of the dark Coalsack Nebula extends into Musca, and the [Musca and Chamaeleon clouds](id:cahlon-cloud-20), among the nearest molecular clouds, stretch across this region.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Muscae](hip:61585) is a hot blue star that pulsates gently. [Beta Muscae](hip:62322) is a binary of two blue stars, and [Lambda Muscae](hip:57363) a white star 138 light-years away.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Musca contains the Spiral Planetary Nebula, NGC 5189, and the globular cluster NGC 4833.
